sql: SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE upper(trim(avg_cpa_currency)) IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')) valid_cpa, count(*) FILTER(WHERE upper(trim(avg_cpt_currency)) IN ('USD','EUR','GBP','JPY','AUD','CAD')) valid_cpt FROM raw.apple_search_ad_group_report_data

SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE conversions_value IN ('true','false')) bool_value,count(*) FILTER(WHERE view_through_conversions IN ('true','false')) bool_view FROM raw.google_ads_account_stats_data

SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "FOLLOWS" IS NULL) "FOLLOWS_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "FOLLOWS" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("FOLLOWS" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "FOLLOWS_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "FOLLOWS" IN ('true','false')) "FOLLOWS_bool",count(*) FILTER(WHERE "LIKES" IS NULL) "LIKES_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "LIKES" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("LIKES" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "LIKES_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "LIKES" IN ('true','false')) "LIKES_bool",count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COMMENTS" IS NULL) "COMMENTS_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COMMENTS" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("COMMENTS" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "COMMENTS_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COMMENTS" IN ('true','false')) "COMMENTS_bool",count(*) FILTER(WHERE "SHARES" IS NULL) "SHARES_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "SHARES" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("SHARES" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "SHARES_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "SHARES" IN ('true','false')) "SHARES_bool",count(*) FILTER(WHERE "CTR" IS NULL) "CTR_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "CTR" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("CTR" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "CTR_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "CTR" IN ('true','false')) "CTR_bool",count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COST_PER_CONVERSION" IS NULL) "COST_PER_CONVERSION_null", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COST_PER_CONVERSION" IS NOT NULL AND try_cast("COST_PER_CONVERSION" AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) "COST_PER_CONVERSION_invalid_numeric", count(*) FILTER(WHERE "COST_PER_CONVERSION" IN ('true','false')) "COST_PER_CONVERSION_bool" FROM raw.tiktok_campaign_report_hourly_data

SELECT count(*) n, count(*) FILTER(WHERE mobile_conversion_installs_order_quantity IS NOT NULL) candidate_present, count(*) FILTER(WHERE try_cast(mobile_conversion_installs_order_quantity AS BIGINT)=0) candidate_zero FROM raw.twitter_campaign_report_data
